cohort: Women with clinical features of abruptio placenta attending Bugando Medical Centre (BMC) in northwest Tanzania between October 2012 and April 2013.
finding: The incidence of abruptio placenta at BMC is high (2.5%) and is associated with poor maternal and foetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with perinatal death (p=0.001).
gest_age: Prematurity was observed in 82.1% of the neonates affected by abruptio placenta.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 48.4% of the neonates affected by abruptio placenta and was associated with perinatal death.
